questions.question:
Study the diagram given below and fill in the blanks with suitable words:
In order to prove that carbon dioxide is necessary for (a) _____ a potted plant is placed in dark for 48 hours to (b) ______ the leaves. A part of a leaf is inserted into a conical flask containing potassium hydroxide solution. This is to absorb (c) _____ from the flask. The plant is then placed in sunlight for a few hours. The experimental leaf is tested for starch. The part of the leaf that was inside the conical flask turns (d) ______, whereas the part of the leaf outside turns (e) ________ in colour.

answer_items.prompt: (b) placed in dark 48 hours to ____ the leaves

questions.solution: (a) Photosynthesis (b) Destarch (c) Carbon dioxide (d) Brown (e) Blue-black
questions.figure_desc: Experimental set-up (moist cotton/potted plant) with part of a leaf inserted into a conical flask containing potassium hydroxide solution (CO2 necessity experiment).

questions.topic: Odd one out and category (mixed chapters)
questions.question:
Choose the odd one out from the following terms and name the category to which the others belong:
(a) Prothrombin, Thrombin, Fibrinogen, Albumin
(b) Tonsils, Glomerulus, Spleen, Lymph nodes
(c) Neutrophils, Basophils, Monocytes, Eosinophils
(d) Leaves, Styrofoam, Grass, Cow Dung
(e) Pulmonary artery, Renal artery, Coronary artery, Hepatic artery
questions.solution:
(a) Odd one: Albumin; others are clotting factors.
(b) Odd one: Glomerulus; others are parts of the lymphatic system.
(c) Odd one: Monocytes; others are granulocytes.
(d) Odd one: Styrofoam; others are biodegradable waste.
(e) Odd one: Pulmonary artery; others carry oxygenated blood.

concepts: (d) cranial nerves: Nervous System and Sense Organs

questions.question:
Given below is a schematic representation of the inheritance of the shape of seeds of garden pea. Answer the questions that follow:
(a) Which is the dominant and recessive allele of the trait?
(b) What does the ratio 3:1 in the F2 generation represent?
(c) State Mendel's Law of Dominance.
questions.solution:
(a) Dominant allele: R (round seeds); recessive allele: r (wrinkled seeds).
(b) In F2, 3:1 means 3 individuals show the dominant phenotype (1 RR + 2 Rr) for every 1 showing the recessive phenotype (rr).
(c) Law of Dominance: in a pair of contrasting characters only one expresses itself while the other remains suppressed.

marking_points.point: (a) Dominant allele (round, R) and recessive allele (wrinkled, r)
(c) Law of Dominance: only one of a pair of contrasting characters expresses, the other is suppressed

questions.figure_desc: Schematic cross of garden pea: parents with round and wrinkled seeds, F1 generation, and F2 generation showing a 3:1 ratio.

questions.question: Define the term ultrafiltration.
questions.solution: Ultrafiltration is the filtration of blood in the glomerulus during which small molecules (water, urea, glucose, amino acids, etc.) pass into the renal tubule (Bowman's capsule) while large molecules remain in the blood, carried away by the efferent arteriole.

concepts: no mitochondria so no oxygen consumption
questions.question: Why are RBCs efficient in their functions though they lack nucleus and mitochondria?
questions.solution: Lack of nucleus makes the cells biconcave, increasing the surface area to volume ratio for absorbing more oxygen. Lack of mitochondria means the red cells cannot use oxygen for themselves, so all the oxygen absorbed in the lungs is delivered to the tissues unconsumed.

marking_points.point: No nucleus: biconcave shape, larger surface area/volume ratio, more oxygen absorbed (also more space for haemoglobin)
No mitochondria: RBCs do not consume the oxygen, so all of it is delivered to tissues
